class.name: DataBuffer
class.brief_description: Bit-packed buffer used to write and read the input of a [TickObject].
class.description: A [DataBuffer] stores values packed in bits. [TickObject] receives one in [method TickObject._collect_input], to write the controller's input, and in [method TickObject._process_tick], to read it back. Values must be read in the same order and with the same sizes they were written. Reading past the written data doesn't print errors: the buffer is marked as failed (see [method is_failed]) and default values are returned.

method.name: add_bool
method.description: Writes a boolean in 1 bit. Returns [param value].

method.name: add_int
method.description: Writes a signed integer in [param bits] bits (1 to 64), clamped to the range of that size. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_normalized_vector2
method.description: Writes a direction (or zero), compressed according to [param compression_level]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_normalized_vector3
method.description: Writes a direction (or zero), compressed according to [param compression_level]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_positive_unit_real
method.description: Writes a value in the [code][0, 1][/code] range, clamped and compressed according to [param compression_level]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_real
method.description: Writes a floating point value: 64 bits with [constant COMPRESSION_LEVEL_0], 32 bits with [constant COMPRESSION_LEVEL_1], 16 bits otherwise. Returns the value as it's read back. NaN and infinities are written as [code]0[/code] (with an error), and values beyond the range of the encoding (65504 with 16 bits) as its largest value.

method.name: add_string
method.description: Writes a UTF-8 string of at most 65535 bytes.

method.name: add_uint
method.description: Writes an unsigned integer in [param bits] bits (1 to 63), clamped to the range of that size. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_unit_real
method.description: Writes a value in the [code][-1, 1][/code] range, clamped and compressed according to [param compression_level]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_value
method.description: Writes [param value] with [param codec]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_vector2
method.description: Writes a [Vector2]; each component is written as in [method add_real]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: add_vector3
method.description: Writes a [Vector3]; each component is written as in [method add_real]. Returns the value as it's read back.

method.name: begin_read
method.description: Starts reading from the beginning of the buffer.

method.name: begin_write
method.description: Clears the buffer and starts writing.

method.name: get_bit_offset
method.description: Returns the current read or write position, in bits.

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the size of the written data, in bits.

method.name: is_end_of_buffer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while reading, once all the data was read.

method.name: is_failed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a read went past the end of the data or the data was malformed.

method.name: is_reading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while reading, [code]false[/code] while writing.

method.name: read_bool
method.description: Reads a boolean written with [method add_bool].

method.name: read_int
method.description: Reads a signed integer written with [method add_int] and the same [param bits].

method.name: read_normalized_vector2
method.description: Reads a direction written with [method add_normalized_vector2] and the same [param compression_level].

method.name: read_normalized_vector3
method.description: Reads a direction written with [method add_normalized_vector3] and the same [param compression_level].

method.name: read_positive_unit_real
method.description: Reads a value written with [method add_positive_unit_real] and the same [param compression_level].

method.name: read_real
method.description: Reads a value written with [method add_real] and the same [param compression_level]. NaN or an infinity (possible in data from another peer) returns [code]0[/code] and marks the buffer as failed (see [method is_failed]).

method.name: read_string
method.description: Reads a string written with [method add_string]. Bytes that aren't valid UTF-8 (possible in data from another peer) return an empty string and mark the buffer as failed (see [method is_failed]).

method.name: read_uint
method.description: Reads an unsigned integer written with [method add_uint] and the same [param bits].

method.name: read_unit_real
method.description: Reads a value written with [method add_unit_real] and the same [param compression_level].

method.name: read_value
method.description: Reads a value written with [method add_value] and the same [param codec].

method.name: read_vector2
method.description: Reads a [Vector2] written with [method add_vector2] and the same [param compression_level].

method.name: read_vector3
method.description: Reads a [Vector3] written with [method add_vector3] and the same [param compression_level].

constants.constant: Finest precision: 64 bits reals, 10 bits unit reals, 12 bits normalized [Vector2].
32 bits reals, 8 bits unit reals, 11 bits normalized [Vector2].
16 bits reals, 6 bits unit reals, 10 bits normalized [Vector2].
Coarsest precision: 16 bits reals, 4 bits unit reals, 9 bits normalized [Vector2].
